_comment: S1WC-2: additive refinement of S1WC-1 (S1WC-1 config is not modified; its params are reused verbatim). Adds ONE class: dark candidate on a provisional DEM-indicated flattened-water signature. No new thresholds, no normalisation, no terrain flattening, no flood labels. Not a confirmed water mask; the Copernicus Water Body Mask is NOT used.
plateau_rule: non-zero DEM values: 4-neighbour component of exactly equal float values on the 30 m master grid with >= min_plateau_cells cells (a priori value 30 = Stage A raw-mosaic rule; other sizes are reported as sensitivity only). DEM == 0 exactly is flagged regardless of component size. slope == 0 alone is NOT used.
caveats: The DEM-indicated flattened-water signature is provisional: it is not a confirmed permanent-water mask, not a flood exclusion, and not the Copernicus Water Body Mask.
Copernicus GLO-30 flattens water bodies; a DEM value of 0 does not imply mean sea level (EGM2008 datum).
Plateau detection uses only cells inside the AOI (DEM is NoData outside); plateaus mostly outside the AOI may be missed.
TWI is a relative, unvalidated index; slopes below the clamp (0.1 deg) are clamped, so TWI on flat/flattened cells is dominated by the clamp.
Remaining class-1 candidates are NOT confirmed floodwater. Date-level radiometric offsets (see the comparability table) mean counts are not comparable across dates.
